title: Standard of conduct
bodyText: . A person issued a limited lines motor vehicle rental company producer license shall act in good faith, abstain from deception, and practice honesty and equity in all insurance matters.
bodyHtml: [§431:9A-143]  Standard of conduct.  A person issued a limited lines motor vehicle rental company producer license shall act in good faith, abstain from deception, and practice honesty and equity in all insurance matters. [L 2021, c 110, §2]
